title: Couple in Plaid Shirts at Sea Lion Exhibit, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1950s black and white square snapshot featuring a young couple posing together outdoors in matching plaid casual shirts. Behind them is a chain-link fence enclosure featuring a sea lion or seal sitting on a wooden perch, along with signs for a roadside animal attraction. The photo reflects 1950s American tourism, leisure culture, and popular casual fashion trends of the era.
